title: SME inference quick-win cookbook (draft)
body:
Purpose
------
Notes + tiny playbook for SEs and sellers to run 1–3 week micro-pilots with small/mid SMB customers (~$2k–$20k ARR). Focus is fast time-to-value, low risk, measurable wins. Use when a buyer: has a defined high-frequency text workflow (support replies, content generation templates, search/retrieval), limited engineering bandwidth, and sensitivity to cost.

TL;DR
-----
- Run a one-week discovery + config, then a 2–3 week micro-pilot.
- Target 1–2 KPIs: time saved per user OR precision uplift in retrieval, not model novelty.
- Prefer hosted API with tuned batching and prefix cache — reduces ops friction.
- Start with embeddings+rerank or template-assisted generation (constrained prompts) — easiest to measure.

Audience
--------
- SDR/AE running initial pilot conversations with SMEs.
- SEs delivering rapid technical proof.
- Customer success owners prepping product trials.

Quick-win plays (pick 1)
----------------------
1) Support-reply assist (high ROI)
   - Scope: top 10 common ticket types, template-driven responses.
   - Tech: hosted text-generation endpoint + simple slot-fill templates. Use Redwood Optimize suggestions: medium quantization, small batch size (4–8) to keep latency <300ms.
   - KPI: reduce average handle time by 20% or increase CSAT on automated replies by 0.1 point.
   - Minimum success config: 10k tokens/day, prefix cache enabled for repeated templates.

2) Internal knowledge search + brief answer (retrieval+rerank)
   - Scope: HR/Finance/Policy docs (10–50 docs first).
   - Tech: embeddings index (FAISS minimal), embed size tradeoff — use Redwood embedding endpoint + 2-stage rerank.
   - KPI: user satisfaction (thumbs up) > 60% on first delivery, median time to find answer <30s.

3) Marketing microcopy generator (constrained prompts)
   - Scope: landing page hero + 3 variant taglines per product.
   - Tech: generation with high temperature for variability but apply short-length cap and scoring step. Use Redwood Optimize to suggest quantization and response length.
   - KPI: pick-rate by marketing team of generated variants >= 30% compared to baseline.

4) Meeting notes + action extraction (structured output)
   - Scope: 1 recurring sales call per week for pilot group.
   - Tech: streaming transcripts -> structured function output (action items) with verification checkbox.
   - KPI: % action items auto-detected that are accurate >=75%.

5) Simple smart autoresponder for lead qualification
   - Scope: triage inbound leads, surface sales-ready leads.
   - Tech: classification model + short summary; route high-intent to AE inbox.
   - KPI: increase MQL->SQL conversion by relative 15% in pilot cohort.

Sample micro-pilot timeline (3 weeks)
-----------------------------------
- Week 0 (prep, 2–3 days): discovery call, pick 1 KPI, agree dataset + SLAs, legal signoff if necessary.
- Week 1 (setup): seed data, small index, prompt templates, baseline metric capture.
- Week 2 (pilot live): run pilot, daily checks, fix prompt drift, small canary rollback policy ready.
- Week 3 (measure & handoff): aggregate metrics, enable production plan or archive.

Demo / SE checklist (pre-demo)
------------------------------
- Have sample data anonymized and loaded (5–50 examples).
- Baseline numbers captured (current handle time, click-through, conversion).
- Fallback plan: if latency >700ms or error rate >2% switch to cached template path.
- Show cost estimate: tokens/day * projected usage -> monthly $ range (use Redwood per-token pricing).
- Bring two outcomes: quick win (automation) and next-phase ROI (scaling to 500 users).

Pricing heuristics for SMEs
-------------------------
- Offer a fixed micro-pilot fee covering hosting + 3 weeks of support: $3–7k depending on volume.
- If customer wants usage billing after pilot, propose a predictable banded model: e.g., tier A: up to 50k tokens/day ($X), tier B: 50–200k tokens/day ($Y).
- For small customers with security concerns, pitch Dedicated-lite (single-tenant pool) at uplift but emphasize predictable throughput.

Objection handling snippets
--------------------------
- "We can't afford the risk" -> "We do a short, fixed-scope pilot and measure a single KPI; we build a fallback so your team keeps the original flow if anything goes wrong."
- "Latency is a dealbreaker" -> "For the pilot we bind latency SLOs using batching and prefix caching; if your SLA needs are higher we can map to Dedicated capacity."
- "Data security" -> "We can run with Private (VPC) or remove PII before sending with a local masking step; we provide audit logs for the trial."

Operational notes for SEs (field tips)
------------------------------------
- Keep prompt iterations minimal in live pilot — change once per 24 hours and document.
- Use a canary of 5% traffic before widening to full pilot.
- Watch token usage spikes after new prompts — set daily caps.
- Precompute embeddings for static docs to avoid cold-start costs.

Metrics to capture (baseline vs pilot)
-------------------------------------
- Business KPI (time saved, conversion uplift, leads qualified).
- Model KPIs (latency p50/p95, token usage/day, error rate).
- Quality KPIs (human accept rate, regression on prompt set).

Sample qualification script (AE -> prospect)
------------------------------------------
- "What's the single-most repetitive text task your team does today?"
- "How many of those tasks per week for a typical user?"
- "What's an acceptable turnaround time or answer quality threshold to call this solved?"
- If they say "<1 min" or ">100/week" this is a good pilot candidate.

Open questions / gotchas
------------------------
- Does pricing banding need a legal addendum for multi-month pilots? (ask sales ops)
- For customers on older docs (PDF scans), OCR step adds cost/time — flag early.
- Some SMEs will want multi-lingual support; scope that as separate pilot.

Next steps (for field)
---------------------
- Template email + contract snippet: draft with Sales Ops (owner: Priya Rao).
- Create a 1-page outcomes dashboard template for pilots (owner: Liam O'Connor).
- Run 2 internal dry-run pilots with internal teams by EOD next week.

Notes to self
------------
- Keep this doc intentionally short. Replace with slide 1-pager for pitch once validated by 3 live pilots.
- Collect 3 anonymized before/after screenshots for quick evidence pack.

-- end of notes --
